global_prompt_modifiers.style: Candid street-style portrait photography, raw unretouched skin texture, visible pores, natural skin sheen, authentic expression

step_by_step_assembly: 1. Select a region using region_weights (if mixed_heritage_pool is chosen, pick evenly from mixed_heritage_phenotypes).
2. Select an age bracket using age_cohort_weights, generate a specific integer age within that range, and pull 1 modifier from age_cohort_modifiers.
3. Sample 1 to 2 distinct traits from each anatomical category (face_shape, forehead, eyes, nose, lips, cheekbones, jawline) and 1 skin_tones object.
4. Sample 1 gaze_and_pose and 1 expression from candid_micro_expressions.
5. Sample 1 grooming_realism and 1 accessory from everyday_accessories_and_grooming, plus 1 to 2 items from realism_imperfections_pool.
6. Sample 1 lighting and 1 camera_artifacts from photographic_physics.
7. Combine with modern hair, wardrobe, and urban background from the selected profile.
mixed_heritage_guidelines: Avoid monolithic keywords like 'mixed race' or 'biracial' in the final prompt string; instead, describe the specific intersection of facial anatomy, skin undertone, and hair curl pattern (e.g., 'high cheekbones, medium nasal bridge, warm honey-caramel skin tone, loose 3C curls').
Blend global and local sartorial cues in styling, such as pairing European tailoring (trench coats, slim-cut blazers) with contemporary African streetwear or subtle heritage jewelry.
generation_pipeline_rules.prompt_assembly_template: Candid street-style portrait photography of a {age}-year-old {gender} in {city}, {gaze_and_pose}, {expression}. {face_shape}, {forehead}, {eyes}, {nose}, {lips}, {cheekbones}, {jawline}, {skin_shade} skin with {skin_undertone} undertones. {hairstyle}, {grooming_realism}, wearing {wardrobe} and {accessory}. {age_cohort_modifier}, {realism_imperfections}. {urban_background}, {lighting}, {camera_artifacts}, {global_style}.

gaze_and_pose: looking slightly off-camera toward the left as if listening to someone
head tilted slightly back with a relaxed, unposed posture
caught mid-stride turning slightly toward the lens
squinting subtly against bright natural sunlight
chin resting lightly on one hand at an outdoor table
expression: unposed neutral resting face with relaxed jaw
mid-laugh with genuine eye crinkles and natural teeth
warm, understated smile with soft eyes

grooming_realism: two-week-old haircut with natural hairline regrowth
flecks of silver and gray hair in beard and temples
natural frizz and flyaways haloing curly hair in humidity
minimal no-makeup skin with natural lip texture
subtle everyday makeup with warm terracotta lip gloss
accessories: wired white earphones with one earbud in
thin-rimmed prescription glasses with slight lens reflection
canvas tote bag strap over shoulder

young_adult_18_29: smooth skin elasticity with occasional minor blemishes
fresh razor lineup or styled edges
adult_30_49: subtle smile lines around the mouth and eyes
mature facial bone structure with light under-eye creases
mature_50_75: deeply etched expression lines and crow's feet
natural skin texture variations, age spots, and softened jawline

lighting: harsh afternoon sun casting realistic shadows under the nose and chin
soft overcast daylight with even, natural skin highlights
warm late-afternoon side light grazing skin texture
shaded sidewalk ambient light with bright sunlit street behind
camera_artifacts: 35mm documentary street lens, natural perspective distortion
85mm portrait lens, f/2.8, creamy background bokeh
50mm lens, candid photojournalism aesthetic, subtle film grain
natural dynamic range with deep rich shadows and preserved highlights on dark skin

realism_imperfections_pool: natural under-eye creases and faint dark circles
flyaway baby hairs catching the sunlight
uneven skin pigmentation around the mouth and forehead
natural facial oil sheen on the nose bridge and forehead
